races.paceDynamic: Bankatary will take this field along at a sustainable gallop with no genuine speed horses to challenge the early lead. The modest pace will allow the hold-up brigade including Digger One, Ice To Meet You, Roi De Coeur, and Clarissa Eclipse to get into contention, while prominent runners like Egyptian Pharaoh can track the pace without pressure. With 10 of 13 runners showing hold-up tendencies and only Bankatary committed to the front, this sets up perfectly for closers who can quicken off the steady tempo. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and multiple closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The modest gallop allows the back markers to conserve energy and unleash late kicks. Horses with proven finishing ability can capitalise on the weak early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Egyptian Pharaoh or Bankatary maintains momentum through the race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows a horse tracking close to kick clear before the closers can respond. Position proves crucial when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Cold Fish or Zabeel Small shows significant progression from limited runs
scenarios.body: Unexposed horses often improve dramatically in novice company when the pace suits. Their fresh profiles could surprise more exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Bankatary gets away with very soft fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to conserve energy and find extra when challenged. The field's hold-up bias works against them if they leave it too late.

watchPoints.text: Bankatary could steal this if allowed uncontested lead and soft fractions throughout the 1m2f trip

races.paceDynamic: Durham Castle will set a steady pace from the front with minimal early pressure, as no other confirmed front runners are declared. The prominent group of Change Sings, Alpha Magic, Shiplake, Uncle Don, Sturlasson, Diligently, Toolatetonegotiate and Fleetwater will track behind in a bunched formation. The hold-up horses Righthere Rightnow, Rajaking, Amazonian Dream, Another Abbot and Indian Run will face the challenge of a potentially slow early tempo followed by a fierce sprint finish. This controlled pace dynamic strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick when the tempo lifts, as they avoid both the burden of making the running and the traffic problems facing the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack tracks Durham Castle smoothly and times their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The bunched group behind the leader will unleash a coordinated assault in the final two furlongs, with those best positioned having decisive advantages. Hold-up horses will struggle to pick their way through traffic as the field compacts approaching the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Durham Castle Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Durham Castle's class advantage and light racing schedule allows him to repel all challengers
scenarios.body: The 5-year-old's superior rating and 79-day break will prove decisive as he maintains his gallop when the prominent runners challenge. His two wins from similar front-running tactics give him the tactical template for success.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves genuinely slow and creates gaps for late runners
scenarios.body: The methodical tempo will allow Righthere Rightnow and Another Abbot to secure clear runs through tiring horses in the final furlong. Their superior turn of foot will prove decisive once they navigate clear racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Durham Castle goes too fast early trying to shake off persistent prominent challengers
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure will compromise all front-running and prominent horses in the closing stages. Late-running specialists will sweep past exhausted leaders with their superior stamina reserves intact.

watchPoints.text: Durham Castle's price will reveal connections' confidence after his 79-day break in this competitive handicap

races.paceDynamic: Solar Invincible stands as the lone confirmed front runner and will set an uncontested lead, with Bella Delizia the only other prominent runner potentially tracking early. The majority field comprises hold-up horses (Mister Moet, Runamara, Rosieisme Darling, Little Jaybee, Sea Her Excel, Viking Glory, Truly Glamorous) who will settle behind this modest early pace. With minimal early pressure, Solar Invincible can dictate comfortable fractions before the field converges in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large group of hold-up horses in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Invincible gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: Solar Invincible faces no early pressure and can quicken off steady fractions while the pack behind struggles with traffic. The lone pace-setter holds off late challengers who emerge too late from the crowded field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade times their challenge perfectly despite traffic concerns
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses manages to navigate through cleanly in the final furlong, overwhelming Solar Invincible's moderate pace advantage. Superior class tells as the better-rated closers find racing room at the crucial moment.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Bella Delizia stalks Solar Invincible and pounces at the optimal moment
scenarios.body: Bella Delizia settles perfectly in second, avoids the traffic that engulfs the hold-up horses, and strikes with a well-timed challenge. The prominent position proves the perfect compromise between pace advantage and finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Creates Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get severely hampered, allowing an unfancied runner clean passage
scenarios.body: Traffic problems are extensive in the final two furlongs, eliminating several fancied runners and creating opportunities for those with cleaner passages. An outsider benefits from the misfortune of others to claim an unlikely victory.

watchPoints.text: Solar Invincible must be watched for any signs of early pressure as the lone pace-setter cannot afford to be rushed through early fractions

races.paceDynamic: Alasrae is the sole genuine front-runner and will dictate from the gate, with Riley Rocks, Born Slippy, Marcellinus, Hayynah and Visually forming the prominent pack behind. The sustainable pace created by this setup will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses - Calling A Star, Ecclefechan, Our Guy, Shahik, Echo Of Faith and Akabusi - to mount challenges from off the pace. With only one confirmed leader and multiple closers armed with tactical speed, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid tempo and deliver their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Alasrae sets reasonable fractions and the prominent horses track kindly
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up runners get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed in the final two furlongs. Patient jockeys like Egan, Donohoe and Hornby can pick their moments and exploit the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian or Alasrae ties up
scenarios.body: The horses tracking in second and third gear can kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized. Riley Rocks and Marcellinus are best positioned to capitalize on their handy positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Alasrae Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the George Boughey runner gets an uncontested lead and quickens at the right moment
scenarios.body: Jack Callan can dictate his own fractions and have enough left to repel late challenges in a front-running performance. The lack of early pace pressure plays into Alasrae's hands perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Alasrae goes too slow early then multiple horses charge together
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with prominent and hold-up horses all arriving simultaneously in a bunched finish. The most balanced horse on the day prevails in a lottery-style conclusion.

races.paceDynamic: Stipulation is the only confirmed front runner with Jimmy Mark likely to track prominently, creating a sustainable early pace without pressure. The remaining seven runners are all hold-up horses who will settle behind this modest early gallop. This will result in a steady tempo that builds gradually, with the main action coming late as the large pack of hold-up horses fan out for their challenges in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those hold-up horses with proven tactical speed, as they can position closer to the pace and avoid traffic in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Stipulation gets soft fractions without early pressure from Jimmy Mark
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for the hold-up brigade to peg back, allowing Stipulation to kick clear when the real running begins. This scenario rewards the horse that doesn't have to make up ground and can dictate terms from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Stampede
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine but not excessive with both prominent runners engaged
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will have something to aim at and can unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. This favours the best staying hold-up horses with the strongest recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home with multiple hold-up horses trapped
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with clear runs at a premium, favouring horses drawn wide or those getting first run. This scenario rewards luck and jockey skill over pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Stipulation and Jimmy Mark go too slow and completely die in the straight
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where the hold-up horses with the most natural speed will prevail. This heavily favours those with recent winning form who can quicken fastest.

races.paceDynamic: Court Of Stars will set the pace from the front with Espona Bay tracking prominently, creating a measured gallop over this 1m trip at Windsor. With only two confirmed pace angles and a field dominated by hold-up horses, the early fractions will be sustainable rather than punishing. The tactical verdict strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers who can position close enough to strike, as the lack of genuine pace will create a sprint finish where those with tactical speed and good positioning will dominate over genuine front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Court Of Stars sets modest fractions with most of the field settling behind
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade get the perfect setup to unleash late runs in the final 2f. Horses like Zipwire, Ziggy's Avenger and Twilight Glow benefit from the lack of early pace and can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Espona Bay or Too Hot To Tango position perfectly behind the leader and kick clear 2f out
scenarios.body: The horse that tracks the pace most intelligently gets first run on the field and maintains the advantage to the line. This favours the prominent runners who avoid the late traffic that will engulf the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Court Of Stars goes too slow and the field bunches dangerously approaching the turn
scenarios.body: A messy sprint develops with severe traffic problems for those trapped on the rail. The race becomes a lottery with any horse getting a clear run capable of winning, favouring those drawn wide or with luck in running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Court Of Stars maintains a strong gallop and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms completely and repel all late challenges. This scenario requires the prominent horses to fail in their tracking duties.
